headline: Aarti Industries board approves enabling resolution for fundraising
hook: Enabling approval for future capital raise
summary: Aarti Industries announced that its board of directors met on October 1, 2026, and approved an enabling resolution for fundraising. Enabling resolutions provide the company with the flexibility to raise capital through various instruments in the future when required. This procedural filing does not indicate an immediate issuance or dilution of shares. Retail investors should note this is an enabling authorization rather than an active fundraise.
why_it_matters: Enabling approval permits future fundraising without immediate share dilution.
